headline: H100 SXM and H200 lead weekly gains while MI300X holds best price-performance at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour.
bullets: H100 SXM rose +23% over 7 days to a $5.33 market index, with the widest hyperscaler premium at +147% ($10.68 vs $4.32 neocloud).
H200 climbed +17% to a $6.31 index, with hyperscalers at $10.30 versus $5.40 for neoclouds, a +91% premium.
B200, MI300X, A100 80GB SXM and L40S were flat at +0%, with B200 indexed at $8.50 and A100 80GB SXM at $2.70.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour, with RunPod Community Cloud listing it at $0.50, though only 5 providers carry it.
Vast.ai is cheapest for H100 SXM at $2.20, A100 80GB SXM at $1.08 and L40S at $0.64, while RunPod Community Cloud leads on B200 at $5.98 and H200 at $3.59.
watch: Whether the +23% H100 SXM and +17% H200 moves keep spreading, especially if the +147% H100 SXM hyperscaler premium narrows as neocloud prices respond.
